big_case.notes: Pro se homeowners' decade-long foreclosure and ejectment fight, reaching the Court as a two-day-late notice of appeal and a Rule 4(a)(5) excusable-neglect ruling in an unpublished Third Circuit affirmance. No response filed, no amici, one distribution, denied at the long conference without a noted dissent. Stakes run to one household's property; nothing about the ruling would move Rule 4(a)(5) practice. Formed from the record, outcome, and petition; the predictors' scores sit in the same prediction.json and were visible before this read was fixed.
